items.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio

sentences.en: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers.
It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

items.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe

sentences.en: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

items.title: Thomas Mann returns to his 'Fatherland' in this practically flawless film

sentences.en: <em>Fatherland</em> imagines the Nobel Prize-winning author's 1949 return to Germany after years of exile.
Just 82 minutes long, this gorgeous film is meticulously staged and shot in black and white.
